caseStudy.text: The client wanted a single-storey rear extension to their detached bungalow at 7 Tylewood, Hadleigh.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE designed a flat-roof rear extension, confirmed as falling under permitted development rather than needing a full planning application.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Castle Point Borough Council confirmed the scheme as lawful permitted development in November 2018. Before photos show the bungalow prior to the extension; after photos are not yet available.
